_meta.note: Requirements summarised from public Civil Registration Services guidance. Offices may ask for additional evidence; always confirm with your local registrar. Review this file whenever CRS publishes new guidance.

birth_notification.en: Birth notification (form B1 / acknowledgement slip) from the health facility where the child was born
birth_notification.sw: Taarifa ya kuzaliwa (fomu B1 / risiti) kutoka kituo cha afya mtoto alipozaliwa

chief_letter.en: Letter from the Assistant Chief / Chief confirming the home birth
chief_letter.sw: Barua kutoka kwa Chifu Msaidizi / Chifu inayothibitisha kuzaliwa nyumbani

mother_id.en: Mother's national ID card or passport (original and copy)
mother_id.sw: Kitambulisho cha taifa au pasipoti ya mama (asili na nakala)

father_id.en: Father's national ID card or passport (original and copy)
father_id.sw: Kitambulisho cha taifa au pasipoti ya baba (asili na nakala)

marriage_certificate.sw: Cheti cha ndoa cha wazazi (kama kipo)

joint_parent_consent.en: Joint request by both parents to enter the father's details (both attend, or a signed declaration)
joint_parent_consent.sw: Ombi la pamoja la wazazi wote wawili kuandika maelezo ya baba (wote wahudhurie, au tamko lililotiwa sahihi)

clinic_card.en: Child's clinic / immunisation card (Mother and Child Health booklet)
clinic_card.sw: Kadi ya kliniki / chanjo ya mtoto (kitabu cha Afya ya Mama na Mtoto)

school_record.en: School admission record or leaving certificate showing date of birth
school_record.sw: Rekodi ya kujiunga na shule au cheti cha kumaliza shule kinachoonyesha tarehe ya kuzaliwa

baptism_card.en: Baptism / dedication card or other religious record (if available)
baptism_card.sw: Kadi ya ubatizo / kuwekwa wakfu au rekodi nyingine ya kidini (kama ipo)

age_assessment.en: Age assessment report from a government medical officer (if no early-life records exist)
age_assessment.sw: Ripoti ya makadirio ya umri kutoka kwa daktari wa serikali (kama hakuna rekodi za utotoni)

late_registration_form.en: Completed late registration application form (available at the registrar's office)
late_registration_form.sw: Fomu ya maombi ya usajili wa kuchelewa iliyojazwa (inapatikana ofisi ya msajili)

applicant_id.en: Your own national ID card (for adults applying for themselves)
applicant_id.sw: Kitambulisho chako cha taifa (kwa watu wazima wanaojiombea)

guardian_proof.en: Proof of guardianship (court order, letter from children's officer or chief)
guardian_proof.sw: Uthibitisho wa ulezi (amri ya mahakama, barua ya afisa wa watoto au chifu)

police_abstract.en: Police abstract reporting the loss of the original certificate
police_abstract.sw: Ripoti ya polisi (abstract) kuhusu kupotea kwa cheti cha awali

certificate_copy.en: Copy of the lost certificate or its entry number (if known)
certificate_copy.sw: Nakala ya cheti kilichopotea au nambari yake ya usajili (kama inajulikana)

original_certificate.en: The original birth certificate that needs correcting
original_certificate.sw: Cheti halisi cha kuzaliwa kinachohitaji kusahihishwa

correction_evidence.en: Evidence supporting the correct details (e.g. ID, school records, clinic card)
correction_evidence.sw: Ushahidi unaothibitisha maelezo sahihi (k.m. kitambulisho, rekodi za shule, kadi ya kliniki)

ecitizen_payment.en: eCitizen payment confirmation for the certificate fee (check current fee on eCitizen)
ecitizen_payment.sw: Uthibitisho wa malipo ya eCitizen kwa ada ya cheti (angalia ada ya sasa kwenye eCitizen)

death_notification.en: Notification of death (form D1) from the health facility where the death occurred
death_notification.sw: Taarifa ya kifo (fomu D1) kutoka kituo cha afya ambapo kifo kilitokea

death_chief_letter.en: Letter from the Assistant Chief / Chief confirming the death
death_chief_letter.sw: Barua kutoka kwa Chifu Msaidizi / Chifu inayothibitisha kifo

deceased_id.en: Deceased person's national ID card or passport
deceased_id.sw: Kitambulisho cha taifa au pasipoti ya marehemu

deceased_birth_certificate.sw: Cheti cha kuzaliwa cha marehemu (kama kipo)

informant_id.en: National ID card of the relative reporting the death (the informant)
informant_id.sw: Kitambulisho cha taifa cha jamaa anayeripoti kifo (mtoa taarifa)

police_death_report.en: Police abstract / report for a death from accident, violence or unknown cause
police_death_report.sw: Ripoti ya polisi (abstract) kwa kifo kilichotokana na ajali, vurugu au sababu isiyojulikana

postmortem_report.en: Post-mortem report (if a post-mortem was done)
postmortem_report.sw: Ripoti ya uchunguzi wa maiti (kama ulifanyika)

burial_permit.en: Burial permit (if the deceased has already been buried)

death_affidavit.en: Sworn affidavit by a relative confirming the death, its date and place
death_affidavit.sw: Kiapo cha jamaa kinachothibitisha kifo, tarehe na mahali kilipotokea

death_certificate_copy.en: Copy of the lost death certificate or its entry number (if known)
death_certificate_copy.sw: Nakala ya cheti cha kifo kilichopotea au nambari yake ya usajili (kama inajulikana)
